title: Bike Lanes by Casey Neistat
summary: Casey Neistat's early viral short in which he gets ticketed for not using a bike lane in New York, then shows how often the lanes are blocked by cars and other obstacles. It runs about three minutes.
why: Referenced in bike-lane threads as the classic example of how NYC bike lanes get blocked and how cyclists get ticketed.

quote.text: partially got his start by making a video about people/things blocking the bike lanes in NYC.
